# Going Awesome Places

> > Travel blog by William Tang featuring detailed itineraries, destination guides, and practical travel tips for exploring destinations worldwide.

Going Awesome Places provides comprehensive travel resources including destination-specific itineraries, packing lists, accommodation guides, and travel photography. The site covers popular destinations across Asia, Europe, South America, and Africa, with a focus on trip planning and practical travel advice.

## Key Topics

- Travel Itineraries
- Destination Guides
- Trip Planning
- William Tang
- Bangkok
- Japan (Sapporo)
- Egypt (Abu Simbel, Nile)
- Chile (Patagonia, Atacama, Easter Island)
- Greece (Santorini, Paros)
- Packing Lists
- Travel Photography
- Accommodation Guides
- Travel Tips
- Airplane Hacks
